# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER_WALKFORWARD

**Filed:** 2026-06-27
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER strategy can capture edge by identifying overnight trends and riding the momentum into the next trading day. We hypothesize that this strategy can be improved by optimizing the walk-forward parameters to better capture the underlying trends.

## Mechanism

The SNIPER_OVERNIGHT_GRINDER strategy uses a combination of technical indicators and trend analysis to identify overnight trends. The walk-forward optimization will focus on adjusting the parameters of these indicators to improve the strategy's performance.
